events.title: Nakano Eco Fair
events.summary: Visitors can enjoy eco-friendly lifestyle exhibits, chopstick and strap-making workshops, and a quiz rally.

events.title: Nakano New Face Market
events.venue: Nakano Sunplaza South Square and Nakano City Office
events.summary: Junior and senior high school students sell drinks, sweets, and local products from trailer houses.

events.title: Nakano City Agricultural Produce Direct Sale
events.summary: Local farmers offer fresh, carefully grown vegetables harvested directly within the city.

events.title: Magokoro Marche
events.summary: Everyone can enjoy plastic plate crafting, retro games, portrait corners, and baked goods from welfare facilities.
